title: 420Explorer canonical downstream qualification ledger
authority_rules: This ledger is a downstream projection; EXP-0.2/EXP-0.3 source artifacts remain the normative authorities it must exactly reflect.
Current repository/source evidence is fresh only because the retained verifier chain passed on the EXP-0.4.6 final closeout head.
Historical evidence may support its recorded scope but cannot override current requirement, blocker, AC, address, deployment or qualification status.
Source/integration qualification never implies runtime, deployment, live-network or Genesis qualification.
No requirement or AC may be promoted while any mapped blocker or required evidence layer remains unresolved.
Final Genesis promotion is reserved for exact release-candidate EXP-8 closeout.

promotion_model.requirement_to_genesis: current status -> owned later procedures -> blocker closure -> mapped AC satisfaction -> exact release-candidate qualification -> EXP-8 closeout
promotion_model.blocker_to_closed: open finding -> remediation -> applicable runtime/deployment/security/live witness -> authoritative register update -> exact-head requalification
promotion_model.acceptance_to_satisfied: unverified -> all required evidence current on exact release candidate + zero mapped open blockers -> EXP-8 evidence index -> satisfied
promotion_model.freshness_rule: Evidence that is environment-bound or release-candidate-bound must be rerun when its environment/release candidate changes; repository evidence is revalidated by the retained exact-head chain.
